summary: Comprehensive testing of Golf Charity Platform completed. Backend API testing achieved 90% success rate (18/20 tests passed). Frontend testing confirmed all major pages load correctly with proper navigation and UI elements. Authentication flows work for both users and admins. Minor issues found with user session persistence and some API endpoints.

critical_bugs.impact: Users cannot view their draw results

integration_issues.note: Expected in sandbox environment - requires valid Polar.sh credentials

ui_bugs.issue: Authentication session not persisting - users redirected to login

integration_issues.issue: Login successful but dashboard access fails - token not persisting in localStorage

design_issues.issue: Back to home and signup/login links missing on some auth pages

passed_tests: Landing page loads with all sections (hero, how-it-works, charity spotlight, prize pool, CTA)
User and admin login authentication working
API endpoints for charities, scores, admin functions working
Charities page loads with featured charities and search functionality
Subscription page displays both plans with checkout buttons
Draws page shows appropriate 'no draws yet' message
Admin dashboard loads with overview stats and navigation
Form elements present and functional on auth pages
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix user dashboard authentication persistence issue - users can login but cannot access dashboard due to session/token not persisting. Also investigate /api/draws/my-results 500 error. Polar.sh checkout requires valid sandbox credentials.
